AZR_Entrance.text: PUBLIC ENTRANCE — World-class glass-and-water arrival plaza with families, influencers, sponsor signage, bright uniforms, and a huge SEA TURTLE THURSDAYS banner.

AZR_OpsRoom.text: BACKSTAGE OPS ROOM — Clean, technical, busy control space with readable monitors for water systems, guest counts, sponsor arrivals, weather, and animal-care schedules.

AZR_MediaPrep.text: PUBLIC MEDIA PREP ZONE — Ring lights, sponsor backdrop, turtle imagery, polished content-production setup adjacent to public space.

AZR_GlassCorridor.text: GLASS CORRIDOR — Transitional space between glossy public spectacle and backstage operations, with the park visibly gleaming beyond the glass.

AZR_GuestExperienceSuite.text: GUEST EXPERIENCE SUITE — Sleek sponsor-facing meeting area with polished slide decks, gift bags, institutional branding, and controlled executive presentation.

AZR_TurtleQueue.text: TURTLE PAVILION PUBLIC QUEUE — Beautiful guest-facing space with overproduced Sea Turtle Thursdays signage, families, kids, VIPs, sponsor wall, and clear sightlines toward the habitat.

AZR_ServiceCorridor.text: TURTLE PAVILION STAFF CORRIDOR — Clean staff-only path with labeled gear, carts, water-testing station, habitat windows, and protected access to the quiet-zone door.

AZR_FinfluencerStage.text: TURTLE PAVILION MINI-STAGE — Polished sponsor backdrop and media setup near the habitat; initially positioned too close to the quiet-zone staff door.

AZR_PublicViewing.text: TURTLE PAVILION PUBLIC VIEWING AREA — Refined guest space beside the habitat, capable of being reframed into calm, respectful viewing without reducing its premium feel.

AZR_BackstageHuddle.text: BACKSTAGE SERVICE CORRIDOR — Compact clean working corridor where the ensemble can huddle quickly without losing the visible sense of a busy park around them.

AZR_BreakArea.text: BACKSTAGE BREAK AREA — Clean employee decompression space with sea-turtle cupcakes after the event.

AZR_StaffOverlook.text: STAFF OVERLOOK / LOADING-DOCK EDGE — Quiet end-of-day staff area with a view of the gorgeous park glowing at sunset; public magic remains visible at a distance.

AZR_DolphinGallery.text: DOLPHIN GALLERY — Luminous, high-draw public habitat with sweeping blue glass, controlled keeper return points, clear guest barriers, premium sightlines, and enough public space for a calm trainer-led retrieval demonstration.

AZR_DolphinBackstage.text: DOLPHIN CARE BACKSTAGE — Clean professional animal-care and behavior workspace adjoining the habitat, with trainer stations, behavior logs, approved objects, locked storage, staff-only access, and no grimy industrial texture.

AZR_FoodCourt.text: AZURE REACH FOOD COURT — Bright, polished family dining area with digital menus, playful marine-themed food presentation, clean service counters, and sightlines toward public exhibits.

AZR_ServiceDock.text: QUIET SERVICE DOCK — Clean end-of-day working edge beside the dolphin habitat, with dimming stadium lights, water reflecting sunset, soft pump ambience, and distant public spectacle.

AZR_TidepoolBackstage.text: TIDEPOOL CARE BACKSTAGE — Clean, controlled wet-side care workspace with rotation tanks, labeled tools, clocks, water-testing equipment, protected staff access, and no public handling area.

AZR_TidepoolGallery.text: TIDEPOOL GALLERY — Bright public tidepool room with shallow staff-supervised wet-edge stations, open general viewing, discreet program boundaries, blue glass, stone and stainless detailing, and clear staff/service paths.

AZR_VIPLounge.text: VIP LOUNGE — Compact polished hospitality room near the tidepool gallery with seating, water, premium program materials and a fully accessible route; never a substitute for backstage access.

AZR_TidepoolMicroscopeSalon.text: TIDEPOOL MICROSCOPE SALON — Public-side interpretation alcove with a live microscope feed enlarged onto blue glass, an educator position, restrained premium graphics and no access to restricted control systems.

AZR_RayGallery.text: RAY GALLERY — Sweeping luminous public habitat with deep blue sightlines, a normal staff feeding zone, multiple public-side camera positions and clear separation from backstage care access.

AZR_RayBackstage.text: RAY CARE BACKSTAGE — Clean professional behavior and feeding workspace with approved food storage, logs, staff stations and protected access; no cameras enter this restricted working area.

AZR_StreamControl.text: STREAM CONTROL — Compact professional public-media control booth overlooking approved habitat cameras, with program monitors, comment moderation, stream delay controls and no exposed private operational screens.

AZR_ConservationHub.text: CONSERVATION HUB — Bright central public campaign space with the Conservation Wall, optional passport pickup, education stations, sponsor presence and enough open circulation to avoid turning participation into a queue.

AZR_ParkPromenade.text: PARK PROMENADE — Wide primary public circulation route connecting major exhibits, food, education and accessibility paths; campaign activations must not consume its clear movement lanes.

AZR_GalaAtrium.text: ANNIVERSARY GALA ATRIUM — Azure Reach's glass-and-water arrival hall transformed for an elegant evening event with projected sponsor graphics, edge-based hospitality and a protected central guest route; bright aquatic prestige, never muddy nightclub darkness.

AZR_LagoonPromenade.text: LAGOON PROMENADE — Broad sunlit water-edge walk with layered blue pools, palms and coastal planting, premium seating, families and staff in motion, and long sightlines into multiple habitats. A natural place for walking conversations because the park never disappears around the characters.

AZR_ReefGallery.text: CORAL REEF GALLERY — Monumental jewel-bright reef window with dense tropical fish, living-coral forms, shafts of blue light and quiet luxury seating. Expensive, immersive and beautiful enough to make people stop mid-conversation.

AZR_KelpWalk.text: KELP FOREST WALK — Tall cool-blue gallery beside a towering kelp habitat; leopard-shark-like silhouettes, schooling fish and swaying kelp create constant vertical motion beyond the glass. Public benches and clean staff access make it useful for decompression and walking dialogue.

AZR_TidepoolTerrace.text: TIDEPOOL TERRACE — Open-air and glass-edged terrace overlooking tidepool habitats and coastal planting, with shaded premium seating, educator stations and visible public circulation. Beautiful without feeling private or sealed off.

AZR_RayOverlook.text: RAY OVERLOOK — Elevated public edge above a sweeping ray and skate habitat, with broad water reflections, elegant railings and views into both guest and keeper zones without exposing restricted care areas.

AZR_ConservationGarden.text: CONSERVATION WATER GARDEN — Lush public garden of mangroves, reeds, freshwater planting, recirculating streams and interpretive water features; a quiet counterpoint to campaign graphics and a place where conservation can be visible without becoming a booth.

AZR_GalaPromenade.text: GALA PROMENADE — Azure Reach's main glass-and-water public spine dressed for a prestige evening but still visibly a marine park: projection on glass, restrained hospitality, open habitat sightlines and expensive event detail that must never bury the living attraction.

AZR_CoralGrandHall.text: CORAL GRAND HALL — Vast multi-story tropical reef panorama with thousands of small reef fish, dramatic coral architecture, reflective stone, discrete donor seating and room for public circulation. It reads as destination architecture, not a meeting room.

AZR_TropicalReefArcade.text: TROPICAL REEF ARCADE — Sequence of smaller jewel-box reef windows with different tropical fish communities, coral shapes and lighting moods. Background tanks may vary page to page; abundance is the point.

AZR_JellyGallery.text: JELLYFISH GALLERY — Darker but luminous gallery of large cylindrical and wall-scale jelly displays, elegant seating and slow colored reflections. Calm, expensive and visually distinct from the bright reef spaces without becoming nightclub-dark.

AZR_PelagicTunnel.text: PELAGIC TUNNEL — Long transparent tunnel through an open-ocean habitat with schooling sardines or mullet, large pelagic fish and occasional tuna-like silhouettes overhead. Visitors keep moving while the water world surrounds them.

AZR_SharkGallery.text: SHARK GALLERY — Expansive deep-water window and tunnel system featuring varied sharks, skates and rays with strong open-water depth. High-status architecture stays subordinate to the animals.

AZR_ArcticBeluga.text: ARCTIC / BELUGA WING — Bright ice-toned water galleries for belugas and compatible Arctic marine interpretation, with pale stone, cool daylight, underwater viewing and warm guest refuge spaces. Luxurious and serene rather than theme-park cartoon Arctic.

AZR_SeaLionCove.text: SEA LION COVE — Large outdoor/indoor coastal habitat with rockwork, deep blue water, haul-out areas and amphitheater-like public edges that can host ordinary observation without requiring a show.

AZR_OtterHabitat.text: OTTER RIVER HABITAT — Lush stream-and-pool environment with underwater windows, planted banks and energetic otters. The animals may be active or absent from a particular panel; no forced performance.

AZR_SeahorseConservatory.text: SEAHORSE CONSERVATORY — Intimate high-design gallery of seahorses, pipefish, seagrasses and delicate aquatic plants, with magnified viewing and botanical-display sensibility.

AZR_RainforestFishHall.text: RAINFOREST FISH HALL — Warm planted freshwater gallery with flooded-root habitats, piranhas and other South American or tropical freshwater fish, humid greenery and dramatic blackwater/river displays.

AZR_PiranhaGallery.text: PIRANHA GALLERY — Refined freshwater exhibit with dense planted river habitat, dark wood/root forms and a large school of piranhas presented as real animals rather than horror props.

AZR_FreshwaterRivers.text: FRESHWATER RIVERS HALL — Long bright sequence of river habitats from cold-water streams to broad freshwater systems, with visible current, rock, wood, plants and region-specific fish. A deliberate expansion beyond ocean-only spectacle.

AZR_TroutStream.text: TROUT STREAM PAVILION — Crystal-clear cold-water run with varied trout forms, submerged stone, fast current and overhead garden light; serene, precise and unusually beautiful for a freshwater exhibit.

AZR_SchoolingFishCylinder.text: SCHOOLING FISH CYLINDER — Towering cylindrical habitat filled with coordinated sardines, mullet or similar schooling fish. The changing geometry of the school creates a living backdrop without needing story attention.

AZR_OpenOceanHall.text: OPEN OCEAN HALL — Immense blue-water viewing room for pelagic species, with fast schooling fish and larger yellowfin/skipjack-like silhouettes moving through deep space; sparse architecture and premium seating emphasize scale.

AZR_UnderwaterDining.text: UNDERWATER DINING ROOM — High-end restaurant with floor-to-ceiling habitat glass, quiet table spacing and elegant service. Marine life remains visible but is not choreographed for diners.

AZR_DonorLounge.text: DONOR LOUNGE — Discreet luxury hospitality space open to a major habitat view, with excellent furniture, restrained service and no sealed boardroom feeling. Conversations remain visually connected to the park.

AZR_VIPArrivalCourt.text: VIP ARRIVAL COURT — Polished private-but-visible arrival terrace off the main public approach, with water, planting, hosts and glimpses of nearby habitats. Prestige comes from ease and service, not isolation from the park.

AZR_PremiumTerrace.text: PREMIUM OBSERVATION TERRACE — Comfortable high-end viewing terrace overlooking multiple aquatic spaces, with champagne-service capability, quiet seating and unobstructed animal sightlines; appropriate for donors without becoming a conference suite.

AZR_MangroveWalk.text: MANGROVE WALK — Immersive brackish-water corridor through mangrove roots, shallow fish habitats, birds-eye and underwater sightlines, dense planting and dappled light.

AZR_AquaticBotany.text: AQUATIC BOTANY ATRIUM — Glass-roofed conservatory of aquatic plants, water lilies, reeds, submerged gardens and fish integrated into landscape-scale water features; a quieter luxury environment where the park feels cultivated rather than branded.

AZR_CoralNursery.text: CORAL NURSERY GALLERY — Public-facing research/interpretation window onto coral propagation tables and colorful small-fish systems. Clean, credible and visually fascinating without turning research into laboratory spectacle.

AZR_TropicalFishRotunda.text: TROPICAL FISH ROTUNDA — Circular sequence of vivid reef and lagoon displays with different tropical fish assemblages in every direction; intentionally allows visual variation and surprise between appearances.
